channels.name: Bio Medical Channel
channels.description: Scientific and biomedical literature, preprints, conference abstracts, and open-access discovery.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.description: Biomedical literature citations from MEDLINE, life science journals, and online books.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.description: Open-access preprint repository with quantitative biology and related papers.

sources.name: bioRxiv
sources.description: Open-access preprint repository for biological sciences.

sources.name: SSRN
sources.description: Open-access research platform with articles and preprints.
sources.notes: Uses Crossref SSRN DOI metadata where available; direct SSRN scraping is not used.

sources.name: ASCO Annual Meeting
sources.description: American Society of Clinical Oncology annual meeting abstracts and proceedings.
sources.notes: Uses Crossref metadata search as a first pass; year-specific archive/PDF parsers can be added later.

sources.name: AACR Annual Meeting
sources.description: American Association for Cancer Research annual meeting abstracts.
sources.notes: Uses Crossref metadata search as a first pass; prior-year archive parsers can be added later.

sources.name: AAN Annual Meeting
sources.description: American Academy of Neurology annual meeting abstracts.
sources.notes: Uses Crossref metadata search as a first pass; source-specific archive parsers can be added later.

sources.name: Unpaywall
sources.description: Open-access location discovery for scholarly articles.
sources.notes: Use only to find legal open-access copies; never bypass paywalls.

channels.name: Financial Fiscal Channel
channels.description: Company financial filings, fiscal signals, and public market context.

sources.name: SEC EDGAR
sources.description: SEC company facts and filing metadata for public companies.
sources.notes: Query should contain ticker symbols or company names, such as MRNA, VRTX, REGN.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.description: Public quote and market context for listed companies.
sources.notes: Best-effort public endpoint; replace with licensed market data for production.

channels.name: VC Confidence Channel
channels.description: Funding, investor, startup momentum, and venture-market confidence signals.

sources.name: VC Confidence Feed
sources.description: RSS/Atom feed-backed venture and startup signal ingestion.
sources.notes: Uses default Google News RSS searches and optional AGENTVC_VC_CONFIDENCE_FEEDS.

sources.name: Business Wire
sources.description: Corporate press releases.
sources.notes: Connector reads configured RSS/Atom feeds via AGENTVC_BUSINESS_WIRE_FEEDS. Do not bypass paywalls; use licensed feeds, official RSS, or public pages only.

sources.name: Substack
sources.description: Subscription-based expert and investor commentary.
sources.notes: Connector reads configured publication RSS feeds via AGENTVC_SUBSTACK_FEEDS. Use public/authorized feeds only.

channels.name: Market and Background Channel
channels.description: Industry news, competitive landscape, partnerships, licensing, and broader market context.

sources.name: Market Background Feed
sources.description: RSS/Atom feed-backed market and background ingestion.
sources.notes: Uses default Google News RSS searches and optional AGENTVC_MARKET_BACKGROUND_FEEDS.

sources.name: Business Wire
sources.description: Corporate press releases and company announcements.
sources.notes: Connector reads configured RSS/Atom feeds via AGENTVC_BUSINESS_WIRE_FEEDS.

sources.name: Yahoo Finance
sources.description: Public market quote context.

sources.name: ClinicalTrials.gov
sources.description: US and international clinical study registry records.

sources.name: International Clinical Trials Registry Platform
sources.description: WHO clinical trial registry search portal.
sources.notes: Uses public ICTRP search portal parsing as a first pass. Official ICTRP XML web service may require WHO arrangement/cost recovery.

sources.name: PubMed
sources.description: Preclinical and clinical biomedical literature citations.

sources.name: bioRxiv
sources.description: Biological science preprints and datasets where available.

sources.name: arXiv
sources.description: Open preprint records relevant to quantitative biology and computational methods.

channels.name: Patent Channel
channels.description: Patent and IP evidence around biotech assets, platforms, targets, and companies.

sources.name: Google Patents
sources.description: Search and find patents from across the world.
sources.notes: Uses Google Patents public XHR/search metadata best-effort. Prefer PatentsView/USPTO, EPO OPS, Lens, or another licensed provider for production claims/drawings coverage.
